_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE right forearm and hand volume from her torso CT (scripts/vhf_arm_bones_ct.py: the male's marker-controlled watershed on the smoothed CT with her TotalSegmentator humerus as the marker; scripts/vhf_arm_bones_ship.py groups the hand), plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Her arms are clipped by the CT's 480 mm field of view: the right radius is nearly complete (191 mm), the right ulna's proximal part is outside the field (119 mm kept), the hand lies within it; the LEFT arm is outside the field and is not in this volume. Hand groups by planes from the wrist (carpals < 45 mm, metacarpals 45-115, phalanges beyond), not separated bones.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female 'Normal' CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 humerus label as marker.

radius_right.note: Nearly complete (191 mm of about 220): the distal end lies within the field of view.

ulna_right.note: Proximal half outside the CT field of view (119 mm kept).

carpals_right.note: Plane group from the wrist, < 45 mm.
